Local Design Lab · final specification pass

Financials, Safety Signals, and one process card

Billing became Financials and gained Add charge. Health gained Safety Signals. Journey and What's Next became one card that renders three different Business Processes from configuration alone — and the convergence plan says exactly what to build.

Process 216 vs 467Financials 442Detail 649 typecheck rc=0

Financials renamed · reconciling 1023 × 442

Named Financials because the card carries charges, fees, funding, credits, payer responsibility, payments, past due, payment setup and history. Billing is the Business Process; the card is broader than it.

Current Period now groups explicitly, and only the totals carry weight — individual rows are regular tabular figures. It reconciles on screen: 1,850 + 75 + 40 − 185 − 600 = $1,180 responsibility; − 925 = $255 balance; past due $255.

Add charge configuration-driven the gap it names

Driven entirely by financial_charge_templates — the L1 commercial configuration. The template decides the form: amount_strategy (fixed locks the amount, manual lets the operator set it, rate_derived resolves it), billable_on (the default due date), responsibility (household · employer · third_party · agency), and whether a subject or note is required. Nothing about a charge type is hardcoded, and no fee definition is duplicated into the card.

The gap

There is no registered action definition for adding a charge. financial_charge_templates exists, createChildcareDraftCharge and postChildcareCharge exist — and nothing in lib/adminV2/actions/definitions wraps them. This is a thin wrapper over services that already work, and it is the highest-value item in the plan.

Financials detail ledger-first 1023 × 649

The top is a condensed strip and a payer row — not a re-render of the summary card. The ledger owns the body, grouped by billing period with prior periods collapsed, carrying both the kind filters and the payer filter. The payer filter is a filter over canonical truth, never a separate payer ledger. Still no running balance column, and the card still says why.

Business Process Journey + What's Next, combined 216 vs 467

Three configured processes, one component, no branching. Enrollment 216px, Assignment 195px, Billing 216px — all from configuration alone. Ownership is not merged: stage stays with the Business Process, work and actions with Current Work, missing information with Readiness.

Hard constraint

No durable stage-history store exists. Past entry and completion dates come from mutation events, and a skipped stage can only ever be an inference. The card must never fabricate a date, and this must not be solved by storing history inside the card — gap P1 is a durable process-stage-history projection, and View process → is gated on it.

Safety Signals projection, never a copy

canonical health fact → configured signal eligibility → permission and context evaluation → projection. Health remains the single owner. The organization configures which fact types project and to which surfaces — the specimen shows dietary reaching Meals while the EpiPen signal does not. Only the minimum operationally useful fact is revealed: “Peanut allergy · severe”, never the medical note behind it.

Do not ship yet

Health visibility is not a field-level permission today (S2). The permission-evaluation step is specified but not enforceable — so shipping signals now would project health information past a policy that does not exist. S2 must land first.

Combined Focus Panel — one fewer card

Convergence plan — what to build, in order

The Financials read model is buildFamilyFinancialsReadModel(customerId, period), owned in lib/financials/ and not in the card:

#GapBlocksSize
F0No billing-period conceptPeriod grouping, "current period"Derivable — no new table
F5No registered Add Charge actionAdd chargeThin wrapper
A1Health fields bind to enrollmentDurable child healthSmall
P1No durable stage-history projectionJourney history, View processMedium
G1Expanded body capped at 360pxBoth details, Household, ChildrenDecision
D1kind: "document" not authorableHealth document requirementsMedium
F3 → F6No responsibility split; no payer attributionThe payer filterSmall then medium
B1No person_health_factsAllergy / condition / medicationLarge
S2 → S1No health field-permission; no signal configSafety SignalsBlocking for S1
F1 / F2Autopay unowned; method is household-scopedPayment zone fidelitySmall
F4No authoritative running balance—Do not build

Recommended order: F0 → F5 → A1 → P1 → G1 → D1 → F3/F6 → B1 → S2/S1. Registration onto real Surfaces happens per card as its read model lands — never as a batch, and never ahead of the truth it projects.
